Ualá es un neobanco en el que confían +11 millones de personas en Argentina, México y Colombia. Fundado en octubre de 2017 por Pierpaolo Barbieri, tiene como misión llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al siglo XXI. Desde una sola app, permite gestionar las finanzas de forma fácil: abrir una cuenta gratuita, pagar, solicitar préstamos, invertir, cobrar con Ualá Bis y acceder al programa de beneficios y fidelización Ualá+, entre muchas otras funcionalidades.

Fue la ronda de inversión privada más grande en América Latina en los últimos tres años. Cuenta con el respaldo de inversores de primer nivel, como Tencent, SoftBank Latin America Fund, Soros Fund Management, Ribbit Capital, Jefferies, Bessemer Venture Partners, Point72, Greyhound Capital, Goldman Sachs y Monashees.

Porque sólo el mejor equipo puede crear el mejor producto, en Ualá apuntamos a la excelencia. Más de 1300 personas forman parte del equipo, con oficinas propias en Argentina, México y Colombia. Además, la compañía fue reconocida como uno de los mejores lugares para trabajar en América Latina. Actualmente hay búsquedas abiertas en los tres países, que pueden consultarse en www.ua.la/sumate. 

#SomosUalá #LoHacemosFácil

Más información en www.ua.la

Finamp is a white‑label

properties.name: Finamp
properties.description:
Finamp is a white‑label digital banking platform that enables companies to launch investor‑ready neobank, wallet, and embedded‑finance products in weeks instead of years. Built as a modular, cloud‑native fintech stack, it lets founders and product teams focus on branding, user experience, and go‑to‑market while Finamp handles the underlying banking infrastructure, compliance, and integrations.

What Finamp Is
Finamp is a “Finance Services Amplifier”: a bank‑grade, white‑label platform that powers digital banks, payment apps, and financial ecosystems under your own brand. It combines a high‑speed core ledger, mobile and web banking interfaces, and a rich set of financial modules so you can ship a production‑ready product without building a core banking system from scratch.

Core Technology Platform
At the heart of Finamp is a high‑performance, secure ledger designed for excellent transactions‑per‑second (TPS) and multi‑AZ resilience, giving businesses both speed and business agility. The platform is cloud‑native, supports region‑specific deployments, and integrates with major hosting providers to meet local infrastructure and regulatory requirements.

Finamp’s architecture is modular, so you can start with a lean stack (for example, core banking plus mobile banking) and add modules as your business scales. 

Use Cases And Target Clients
Finamp is used by a wide range of clients, from early‑stage fintech startups to established enterprises and retailers looking to embed financial services into their ecosystems. Typical use cases include:
▪️Neobanks & Challenger Banks: launching a fully branded digital bank with accounts, cards, and payments without building core banking in‑house.

▪️Payment Apps & Wallets: deploying a region‑optimized wallet or P2P payment product with multi‑currency support and fast onboarding.

▪️Embedded Finance: integrating banking‑grade capabilities into non‑financial brands such as marketplaces, SaaS platforms, or retail chains

properties.name: Finexus
properties.description:
Finexus – Where Banks Meet Innovation

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.

VISIÓN: Queremos revolucionar la inclusión financiera en Latinoamérica acercando a nuestros clientes a diversas oportunidades económicas; apoyando el crecimiento inclusivo del ecosistema y posicionándonos como la empresa líder en opciones de financiamiento basados en Tecnología.

entity.name: Finamp
entity.description:
Finamp is a white‑label digital banking platform that enables companies to launch investor‑ready neobank, wallet, and embedded‑finance products in weeks instead of years. Built as a modular, cloud‑native fintech stack, it lets founders and product teams focus on branding, user experience, and go‑to‑market while Finamp handles the underlying banking infrastructure, compliance, and integrations.

What Finamp Is
Finamp is a “Finance Services Amplifier”: a bank‑grade, white‑label platform that powers digital banks, payment apps, and financial ecosystems under your own brand. It combines a high‑speed core ledger, mobile and web banking interfaces, and a rich set of financial modules so you can ship a production‑ready product without building a core banking system from scratch.

Core Technology Platform
At the heart of Finamp is a high‑performance, secure ledger designed for excellent transactions‑per‑second (TPS) and multi‑AZ resilience, giving businesses both speed and business agility. The platform is cloud‑native, supports region‑specific deployments, and integrates with major hosting providers to meet local infrastructure and regulatory requirements.

Finamp’s architecture is modular, so you can start with a lean stack (for example, core banking plus mobile banking) and add modules as your business scales. 

Use Cases And Target Clients
Finamp is used by a wide range of clients, from early‑stage fintech startups to established enterprises and retailers looking to embed financial services into their ecosystems. Typical use cases include:
▪️Neobanks & Challenger Banks: launching a fully branded digital bank with accounts, cards, and payments without building core banking in‑house.

▪️Payment Apps & Wallets: deploying a region‑optimized wallet or P2P payment product with multi‑currency support and fast onboarding.

▪️Embedded Finance: integrating banking‑grade capabilities into non‑financial brands such as marketplaces, SaaS platforms, or retail chains

entity.name: Finexus
entity.description:
Finexus – Where Banks Meet Innovation

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.

entity.name: Vexi
entity.description:
Somos una Startup fundada en el 2016 con el objetivo de dar acceso a los jóvenes mexicanos al sistema financiero utilizando la tecnología a nuestro favor, para crear procesos eficientes, accesibles y transparentes; todo esto por medio de nuestra propia tarjeta de Crédito, la cual se administra completamente por medio de nuestra aplicación.

Fácil, rápido y sin comprobar ingresos. Para que nunca tengas que volver a pararte en un banco.

SABÍAS QUE?
Solamente el 9% de las transacciones en México se generan por medio de una tarjeta de Crédito, mientras que la media Internacional es del 35%? 

Esto se debe entre otras cosas a:

- La ineficiencia y burocracia del sistema financiero actual, que cierra las puertas a un gran porcentaje de la población que no cubre sus requisitos o que no gana suficiente para ser rentables.

- La desconfianza hacia las instituciones actuales, a sus letras chiquitas, los procesos prolongados y una profunda deficiencia en el servicio.

"​...El acceso al crédito es un vínculo clave entre la oportunidad económica y el resultado económico. Al capacitar a individuos y familias para cultivar oportunidades económicas, la inclusión financiera puede ser un agente poderoso para un crecimiento fuerte e inclusivo"​. - Christine Lagarde (2015) 

MISIÓN: Ser un agente de cambio para nuestros clientes, utilizando la tecnología para brindar, de una forma innovadora, productos financieros flexibles, transparentes y seguros que les brinden acceso a la cultura y sistema financiero.

VISIÓN: Queremos revolucionar la inclusión financiera en Latinoamérica acercando a nuestros clientes a diversas oportunidades económicas; apoyando el crecimiento inclusivo del ecosistema y posicionándonos como la empresa líder en opciones de financiamiento basados en Tecnología.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

Desde el año 1995, comenzó la expansión del negocio y desarrollo nacional, a partir de Córdoba; siendo Tucumán la primera plaza del interior a la que llega Provencred. properties.name: Finexus
properties.description:
Finexus – Where Banks Meet Innovation

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.

entity.name: Provencred
entity.description:
Provencred es una empresa perteneciente al Grupo Comafi, que brinda soluciones financieras para mejorar la calidad de vida de sus clientes, a través de la comercialización de diferentes productos: créditos personales , tarjeta de crédito y Cuota Ya!

Con sus 37 sucursales y 1 receptoria distribuidas en todo el país, junto con un equipo de colaboradores capacitados para asesorar a nuestros clientes; y a través de nuestros productos altamente competitivos en el mercado, Provencred es una empresa referente en el sector financiero no bancarizado.

Provencred surge hace más de 35 años en la ciudad de Córdoba, como una organización familiar dedicada a la financiación del consumo. En el año 1990, nace como una tarjeta de Crédito local emitida en ese entonces por el Banco Provencor. A partir de ese momento, comenzó el desarrollo de Provencred como una herramienta para financiar los consumos y los proyectos de los sectores no bancarizados, a través de la tarjeta de credito y también por su exclusiva línea de creditos personales.

Desde el año 1995, comenzó la expansión del negocio y desarrollo nacional, a partir de Córdoba; siendo Tucumán la primera plaza del interior a la que llega Provencred. Luego desembarcaría en Mendoza, Salta, Jujuy, Santiago del Estero, La Rioja, San Juan, San Luis, Santa Fe, Entre Ríos, Corrientes, Chaco, Misiones,Catamarca,La Pampa y Neuquen.

entity.name: Finamp
entity.description:
Finamp is a white‑label digital banking platform that enables companies to launch investor‑ready neobank, wallet, and embedded‑finance products in weeks instead of years. Built as a modular, cloud‑native fintech stack, it lets founders and product teams focus on branding, user experience, and go‑to‑market while Finamp handles the underlying banking infrastructure, compliance, and integrations.

What Finamp Is
Finamp is a “Finance Services Amplifier”: a bank‑grade, white‑label platform that powers digital banks, payment apps, and financial ecosystems under your own brand. It combines a high‑speed core ledger, mobile and web banking interfaces, and a rich set of financial modules so you can ship a production‑ready product without building a core banking system from scratch.

Core Technology Platform
At the heart of Finamp is a high‑performance, secure ledger designed for excellent transactions‑per‑second (TPS) and multi‑AZ resilience, giving businesses both speed and business agility. The platform is cloud‑native, supports region‑specific deployments, and integrates with major hosting providers to meet local infrastructure and regulatory requirements.

Finamp’s architecture is modular, so you can start with a lean stack (for example, core banking plus mobile banking) and add modules as your business scales. 

Use Cases And Target Clients
Finamp is used by a wide range of clients, from early‑stage fintech startups to established enterprises and retailers looking to embed financial services into their ecosystems. Typical use cases include:
▪️Neobanks & Challenger Banks: launching a fully branded digital bank with accounts, cards, and payments without building core banking in‑house.

▪️Payment Apps & Wallets: deploying a region‑optimized wallet or P2P payment product with multi‑currency support and fast onboarding.

▪️Embedded Finance: integrating banking‑grade capabilities into non‑financial brands such as marketplaces, SaaS platforms, or retail chains

entity.name: Finexus
entity.description:
Finexus – Where Banks Meet Innovation

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.

entity.name: Finexus
entity.description:
Finexus – Where Banks Meet Innovation

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
